task: Parse an AWS S3 bucket name from a full S3 URI (e.g., 's3://my-bucket-name/path/to/object') and extract just the bucket name
solution_criteria: Must correctly extract bucket names from various S3 URI formats, handle bucket names with hyphens and numbers, and work with URIs that have or don't have object paths

task: Write a Python function that takes an AWS IAM policy JSON string and returns a list of all the Actions listed in the policy statements
solution_criteria: Must parse JSON, handle multiple statements, extract Action fields (which can be strings or arrays), and return a deduplicated list of actions

task: Create a JSON template for an AWS CloudFormation parameter that defines an EC2 instance type with constraints to only allow t3.micro, t3.small, or t3.medium
solution_criteria: Must follow CloudFormation parameter syntax, include proper type definition, set allowed values, and include a sensible default value
